description: This line plot illustrates the mean interclass similarity across 64 relation categories for different experimental configurations in a relation extraction task, as described in the paper “Generating Diverse Training Samples for Relation Extraction with Large Language Models.” The x-axis, labeled “Relation Category,” is linear and spans integer values from 0 to 63, with major gridlines and tick labels appearing approximately every 10 units. The y-axis, labeled “Mean Interclass Similarity,” is linear and ranges from 0.0 to 0.5, with major tick marks and gridlines at intervals of 0.1. Five distinct lines are plotted: a solid blue line with circular markers labeled “w/o DPO obo,” which starts at approximately 0.22, peaks sharply at 0.48 around category 2, and generally trends downward with fluctuations; a solid orange line with triangular markers labeled “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint,” which begins near 0.0, rises to 0.19 at category 2, and exhibits high variability with peaks exceeding 0.4; a solid green line with square markers labeled “DPO,” which remains relatively low and stable, mostly between 0.05 and 0.2, with a peak of 0.21 at category 2; a dashed blue line labeled “Average of w/o DPO obo,” which is a horizontal line at approximately 0.107; and a dashed orange line labeled “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint,” which is a horizontal line at approximately 0.158. A faint, semi-transparent gray rectangular region is visible in the legend area, but no corresponding line or data is plotted on the graph for it. The plot also includes three horizontal reference lines: a dashed green line at 0.086, a dashed blue line at 0.107, and a dashed orange line at 0.158, corresponding to the average values of the respective configurations.
